title: Apply for a tattoo master licence
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a tattoo master licence to operate a body art tattooing business in NSW.
intro:
A tattoo master licence allows you to carry on a body art tattooing business in NSW.

If you hold a master licence for the premises as a self-employed sole trader, and, you also perform body art tattooing procedures at the same premises, you do not need a separate tattooist licence.

However, if you hold a master licence on behalf of a corporation, partnership or trust, and you also perform art tattooing procedures at the same premises, you must hold a separate tattooist licence.
who_can_apply: Be an individual and at least 18 years of age.
Be an Australian citizen, permanent resident, or New Zealand citizen.
Not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.
Not be a member of a prescribed criminal organisation or have been a member in the previous 12 months.
what_you_need: Copies of 2 types of acceptable identification documents for yourself.
The PDF form – Nomination of Premises Manager.
For each close associate (if applicable): Your application fee.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to submit your application.

faqs.q: Do I need a separate tattooist licence if I have a master licence?
faqs.a: If you are a self-employed sole trader and perform body art tattooing at the same premises where you hold a master licence, you do not need a separate tattooist licence. However, if you hold a master licence for a corporation, partnership, or trust, and perform art tattooing at the same premises, you must hold a separate tattooist licence.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for a tattoo master licence?
faqs.a: Applicants must be an individual, at least 18 years of age, and must be an Australian citizen, permanent resident, or New Zealand citizen. You must also not be a controlled member of a declared organisation or a member of a prescribed criminal organisation.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about licensing and forms?
faqs.a: Tattoo industry licensing information, including additional forms, application fees, and acceptable identification documents, is available at the NSW Police Force website.
